appearance.subtle: There is a swelling under their jaw on both sides.
appearance.obvious: Glands bulge under their jaw, and their knuckles weep a clear fluid that beads and does not dry.
appearance.extreme: Their jaw is distended around the glands and their hands are permanently wet with venom. Where they rested a palm, the table has gone soft.

description: Glands under your jaw and along your knuckles, full of something that is not supposed to be in a person. Anything you break the skin of gets a dose.
drawbacks: You have to be careful about kissing anyone
name: Venom Glands
